description: Which minepoa.com routes are halted right now per POAScan's own probes (no new request to minepoa.com): Hosted mining, Assignments, Grading, Path actions, Swap writes, Tx lookup, Address lookup and Joining, each open, halted (HTTP 503 with the halt text), down (failing without it) or unknown, with since (when the run of bad reads began), as_of (newest read) and stale. Two bad reads in a row turn a route, two good reads clear it. Joining is the exception: one HTTP 200 from GET /api/join-pow opens it, one HTTP 503 halt read halts that route only, and a timeout does not flip it or keep an older halt. Also swap_route, the one swap order placement status. Use it before telling a user a route works, or when notices say nothing. After each epoch close, answers, grades and assignments pause for about 30 to 60 minutes while the next panels are drawn; a grade submitted in that window can come back not on assigned panel, so wait for the window to pass rather than retrying it.
